chunks: And from one of his sermons (peace be upon him), and in it is a collection of the attributes of Lordship and Divine Knowledge.
ai.seo_question: What are the divine attributes of Lordship and Knowledge mentioned in Imam Ali's sermons?
ai.summary: This passage from Nahj al-Balagha highlights Imam Ali’s (AS) profound theological exposition on God's lordship and infinite knowledge, serving as a cornerstone for Shia metaphysical discourse. It underscores the divine attribute of 'Ilm (knowledge) as all-encompassing, a concept central to understanding God's relationship with creation in Shia scholarship. The text reflects the intellectual depth of the sermon, emphasizing God's transcendence and immanence through His attributes.
